description: Lipid profile. Two things earn this fixture its place. First, HDL Cholesterol has an INVERTED reference bound (> 40) where a value of 38 is LOW -- a flag derivation that naively assumes 'above the bound means high' gets this backwards, and getting HDL backwards inverts the clinical reading. Second, the Vitamin D line contains a genuine OCR garble: '2S.4' (capital S misread for 5). That value MUST come back unparsed with raw preserved, never silently repaired to 25.4 -- see DECISIONS.md D5. Note also that TC/HDL Ratio is unitless, so the unit column is blank.
